ESV.1: I was ready to be sought by those who did not ask for me; I was ready to be found by those who did not seek me. I said, “Here I am, here I am,” to a nation that was not called by  my name.
ESV.2: I spread out my hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, following their own devices;
ESV.3: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens and making offerings on bricks;
ESV.4: who sit in tombs, and spend the night in secret places; who eat pig's flesh, and broth of tainted meat is in their vessels;
ESV.5: who say, “Keep to yourself, do not come near me, for I am too holy for you.” These are a smoke in my nostrils, a fire that burns all the day.
ESV.6: Behold, it is written before me: “I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will indeed repay into their lap
ESV.7: both your iniquities and your fathers' iniquities together, says the LORD; because they made offerings on the mountains and insulted me on the hills, I will measure into their lap payment for their former deeds.”
ESV.8: Thus says the LORD: “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and they say, ‘Do not destroy it, for there is a blessing in it,’ so I will do for my servants' sake, and not destroy them all.
ESV.9: I will bring forth offspring from Jacob, and from Judah possessors of my mountains; my chosen shall possess it, and my servants shall dwell there.
ESV.10: Sharon shall become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, for my people who have sought me.
ESV.11: But you who forsake the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill cups of mixed wine for Destiny,
ESV.12: I will destine you to the sword, and all of you shall bow down to the slaughter, because, when I called, you did not answer; when I spoke, you did not listen, but you did what was evil in my eyes and chose what I did not delight in.”
ESV.13: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Behold, my servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry; behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty; behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be put to shame;
ESV.14: behold, my servants shall sing for gladness of heart, but you shall cry out for pain of heart and shall wail for breaking of spirit.
ESV.15: You shall leave your name to my chosen for a curse, and the Lord GOD will put you to death, but his servants he will call by another name,
ESV.16: so that he who blesses himself in the land shall bless himself by the God of truth, and he who takes an oath in the land shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten and are hidden from my eyes.
ESV.17: “For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth, and the former things shall not be remembered or come into mind.
ESV.18: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for behold, I create Jerusalem to be a joy, and her people to be a gladness.
ESV.19: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and be glad in my people; no more shall be heard in it the sound of weeping and the cry of distress.
ESV.20: No more shall there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not fill out his days, for the young man shall die a hundred years old, and the sinner a hundred years old shall be accursed.
ESV.21: They shall build houses and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
ESV.22: They shall not build and another inhabit; they shall not plant and another eat; for like the days of a tree shall the days of my people be, and my chosen shall long enjoy  the work of their hands.
ESV.23: They shall not labor in vain or bear children for calamity,  for they shall be the offspring of the blessed of the LORD, and their descendants with them.
ESV.24: Before they call I will answer; while they are yet speaking I will hear.
ESV.25: The wolf and the lamb shall graze together; the lion shall eat straw like the ox, and dust shall be the serpent's food. They shall not hurt or destroy in all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.

NKJV.1: “I was sought by those who did not ask for Me; I was found by those who did not seek Me. I said, ‘Here I am, here I am,’ To a nation that was not called by My name.
NKJV.2: I have stretched out My hands all day long to a rebellious people, Who walk in a way that is not good, According to their own thoughts;
NKJV.3: A people who provoke Me to anger continually to My face;  Who sacrifice in gardens, And burn incense on altars of brick;
NKJV.4: Who sit among the graves, And spend the night in the tombs; Who eat swine’s flesh, And the broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
NKJV.5: Who say, ‘Keep to yourself, Do not come near me, For I am holier than you!’ These are smoke in My nostrils, A fire that burns all the day.
NKJV.6: “Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silence, but will repay— Even repay into their bosom—
NKJV.7: Your iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together,” Says the LORD,  “Who have burned incense on the mountains  And blasphemed Me on the hills; Therefore I will measure their former work into their bosom.”
NKJV.8: Thus says the LORD: “As the new wine is found in the cluster, And one says, ‘Do not destroy it, For a blessing is in it,’ So will I do for My servants’ sake, That I may not destroy them all.
NKJV.9: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, And from Judah an heir of My mountains; My elect shall inherit it, And My servants shall dwell there.
NKJV.10: Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, And the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, For My people who have sought Me.
NKJV.11: “But you are those who forsake the LORD, Who forget My holy mountain, Who prepare a table for Gad, And who furnish a drink offering for Meni.
NKJV.12: Therefore I will number you for the sword, And you shall all bow down to the slaughter; Because, when I called, you did not answer; When I spoke, you did not hear, But did evil before My eyes, And chose that in which I do not delight.”
NKJV.13: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Behold, My servants shall eat, But you shall be hungry; Behold, My servants shall drink, But you shall be thirsty; Behold, My servants shall rejoice, But you shall be ashamed;
NKJV.14: Behold, My servants shall sing for joy of heart, But you shall cry for sorrow of heart, And wail for grief of spirit.
NKJV.15: You shall leave your name as a curse to My chosen; For the Lord GOD will slay you, And call His servants by another name;
NKJV.16: So that he who blesses himself in the earth Shall bless himself in the God of truth; And he who swears in the earth Shall swear by the God of truth; Because the former troubles are forgotten, And because they are hidden from My eyes.
NKJV.17: “For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; And the former shall not be remembered or come to mind.
NKJV.18: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; For behold, I create Jerusalem as a rejoicing, And her people a joy.
NKJV.19: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, And joy in My people; The voice of weeping shall no longer be heard in her, Nor the voice of crying.
NKJV.20: “No more shall an infant from there live but a few days, Nor an old man who has not fulfilled his days; For the child shall die one hundred years old, But the sinner being one hundred years old shall be accursed.
NKJV.21: They shall build houses and inhabit them; They shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
NKJV.22: They shall not build and another inhabit; They shall not plant and another eat; For as the days of a tree, so shall be the days of My people, And My elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
NKJV.23: They shall not labor in vain, Nor bring forth children for trouble; For they shall be the descendants of the blessed of the LORD, And their offspring with them.
NKJV.24: “It shall come to pass That before they call, I will answer; And while they are still speaking, I will hear.
NKJV.25: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, The lion shall eat straw like the ox, And dust shall be the serpent’s food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain,” Says the LORD.

NASB.1: 'I permitted Myself to be sought by those who did not ask [for Me]; I permitted Myself to be found by those who did not seek Me. I said, 'Here am I, here am I,' To a nation which did not call on My name.
NASB.2: 'I have spread out My hands all day long to a rebellious people, Who walk [in] the way which is not good, following their own thoughts,
NASB.3: A people who continually provoke Me to My face, Offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on bricks;
NASB.4: Who sit among graves and spend the night in secret places; Who eat swine's flesh, And the broth of unclean meat is [in] their pots.
NASB.5: 'Who say, 'Keep to yourself, do not come near me, For I am holier than you!' These are smoke in My nostrils, A fire that burns all the day.
NASB.6: 'Behold, it is written before Me, I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will even repay into their bosom,
NASB.7: Both their own iniquities and the iniquities of their fathers together,' says the LORD. 'Because they have burned incense on the mountains And scorned Me on the hills, Therefore I will measure their former work into their bosom.'
NASB.8: Thus says the LORD, 'As the new wine is found in the cluster, And one says, 'Do not destroy it, for there is benefit in it,' So I will act on behalf of My servants In order not to destroy all of them.
NASB.9: 'I will bring forth offspring from Jacob, And an heir of My mountains from Judah; Even My chosen ones shall inherit it, And My servants will dwell there.
NASB.10: 'Sharon will be a pasture land for flocks, And the valley of Achor a resting place for herds, For My people who seek Me.
NASB.11: 'But you who forsake the LORD, Who forget My holy mountain, Who set a table for Fortune, And who fill [cups] with mixed wine for Destiny,
NASB.12: I will destine you for the sword, And all of you will bow down to the slaughter. Because I called, but you did not answer; I spoke, but you did not hear. And you did evil in My sight And chose that in which I did not delight.'
NASB.13: Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD, 'Behold, My servants will eat, but you will be hungry. Behold, My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
NASB.14: 'Behold, My servants will shout joyfully with a glad heart, But you will cry out with a heavy heart, And you will wail with a broken spirit.
NASB.15: 'You will leave your name for a curse to My chosen ones, And the Lord GOD will slay you. But My servants will be called by another name.
NASB.16: 'Because he who is blessed in the earth Will be blessed by the God of truth; And he who swears in the earth Will swear by the God of truth; Because the former troubles are forgotten, And because they are hidden from My sight!
NASB.17: 'For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; And the former things will not be remembered or come to mind.
NASB.18: 'But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; For behold, I create Jerusalem [for] rejoicing And her people [for] gladness.
NASB.19: 'I will also rejoice in Jerusalem and be glad in My people; And there will no longer be heard in her The voice of weeping and the sound of crying.
NASB.20: 'No longer will there be in it an infant [who lives but a few] days, Or an old man who does not live out his days; For the youth will die at the age of one hundred And the one who does not reach the age of one hundred Will be [thought] accursed.
NASB.21: 'They will build houses and inhabit [them]; They will also plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
NASB.22: 'They will not build and another inhabit, They will not plant and another eat; For as the lifetime of a tree, [so will be] the days of My people, And My chosen ones will wear out the work of their hands.
NASB.23: 'They will not labor in vain, Or bear [children] for calamity; For they are the offspring of those blessed by the LORD, And their descendants with them.
NASB.24: 'It will also come to pass that before they call, I will answer; and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
NASB.25: 'The wolf and the lamb will graze together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox; and dust will be the serpent's food. They will do no evil or harm in all My holy mountain,' says the LORD.

WEB.1: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.
WEB.2: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;
WEB.3: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;
WEB.4: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
WEB.5: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.
WEB.6: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom,
WEB.7: your own iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says Yahweh, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”
WEB.8: Yahweh says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so will I do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.
WEB.9: I will bring offspring  out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.
WEB.10: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.
WEB.11: “But you who forsake Yahweh, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;
WEB.12: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”
WEB.13: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed;
WEB.14: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.
WEB.15: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen; and the Lord Yahweh will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,
WEB.16: so that he who blesses himself in the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.
WEB.17: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
WEB.18: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.
WEB.19: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.
WEB.20: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.
WEB.21: They will build houses, and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
WEB.22: They will not build, and another inhabit. They will not plant, and another eat: for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.
WEB.23: They will not labor in vain, nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring  of Yahweh’s blessed, and their descendants with them.
WEB.24: It will happen that, before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
WEB.25: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says Yahweh.

NLT.1:
The LORD says, “I was ready to respond, but no one asked for help.
I was ready to be found, but no one was looking for me.
I said, ‘Here I am, here I am!’
to a nation that did not call on my name.
NLT.2:
All day long I opened my arms to a rebellious people.
But they follow their own evil paths
and their own crooked schemes.
NLT.3:
All day long they insult me to my face
by worshiping idols in their sacred gardens.
They burn incense on pagan altars.
NLT.4:
At night they go out among the graves,
worshiping the dead.
They eat the flesh of pigs
and make stews with other forbidden foods.
NLT.5:
Yet they say to each other,
‘Don’t come too close or you will defile me!
I am holier than you!’
These people are a stench in my nostrils,
an acrid smell that never goes away.
NLT.6:
“Look, my decree is written out in front of me:
I will not stand silent;
I will repay them in full!
Yes, I will repay them —
NLT.7:
both for their own sins
and for those of their ancestors,”
says the LORD.
“For they also burned incense on the mountains
and insulted me on the hills.
I will pay them back in full!
NLT.8:
“But I will not destroy them all,”
says the LORD.
“For just as good grapes are found among a cluster of bad ones
(and someone will say, ‘Don’t throw them all away —
some of those grapes are good!’),
so I will not destroy all Israel.
For I still have true servants there.
NLT.9:
I will preserve a remnant of the people of Israel
and of Judah to possess my land.
Those I choose will inherit it,
and my servants will live there.
NLT.10:
The plain of Sharon will again be filled with flocks
for my people who have searched for me,
and the valley of Achor will be a place to pasture herds.
NLT.11:
“But because the rest of you have forsaken the LORD
and have forgotten his Temple,
and because you have prepared feasts to honor the god of Fate
and have offered mixed wine to the god of Destiny,
NLT.12:
now I will ‘destine’ you for the sword.
All of you will bow down before the executioner.
For when I called, you did not answer.
When I spoke, you did not listen.
You deliberately sinned — before my very eyes —
and chose to do what you know I despise.”
NLT.13:
Therefore, this is what the Sovereign LORD says:
“My servants will eat,
but you will starve.
My servants will drink,
but you will be thirsty.
My servants will rejoice,
but you will be sad and ashamed.
NLT.14:
My servants will sing for joy,
but you will cry in sorrow and despair.
NLT.15:
Your name will be a curse word among my people,
for the Sovereign LORD will destroy you
and will call his true servants by another name.
NLT.16:
All who invoke a blessing or take an oath
will do so by the God of truth.
For I will put aside my anger
and forget the evil of earlier days.
NLT.17:
“Look! I am creating new heavens and a new earth,
and no one will even think about the old ones anymore.
NLT.18:
Be glad; rejoice forever in my creation!
And look! I will create Jerusalem as a place of happiness.
Her people will be a source of joy.
NLT.19:
I will rejoice over Jerusalem
and delight in my people.
And the sound of weeping and crying
will be heard in it no more.
NLT.20:
“No longer will babies die when only a few days old.
No longer will adults die before they have lived a full life.
No longer will people be considered old at one hundred!
Only the cursed will die that young!
NLT.21:
In those days people will live in the houses they build
and eat the fruit of their own vineyards.
NLT.22:
Unlike the past, invaders will not take their houses
and confiscate their vineyards.
For my people will live as long as trees,
and my chosen ones will have time to enjoy their hard-won gains.
NLT.23:
They will not work in vain,
and their children will not be doomed to misfortune.
For they are people blessed by the LORD,
and their children, too, will be blessed.
NLT.24:
I will answer them before they even call to me.
While they are still talking about their needs,
I will go ahead and answer their prayers!
NLT.25:
The wolf and the lamb will feed together.
The lion will eat hay like a cow.
But the snakes will eat dust.
In those days no one will be hurt or destroyed on my holy mountain.
I, the LORD, have spoken!”

AMP.1:
"I let Myself be sought by those who did not ask for Me;
I let Myself be found by those who did not seek Me.
I said, 'Here am I, here am I,'
To the nation [Israel] which did not call on My Name.
AMP.2:
"I have spread out My hands all the day long to a rebellious and stubborn people,
Who walk in the way that is not good, [following] after their own thoughts and intentions,
AMP.3:
The people who continually provoke Me to My face,
Sacrificing [to idols] in gardens and making offerings with incense on bricks [instead of at the designated altar];
AMP.4:
Who sit among the graves [trying to conjure up evil spirits] and spend the night in the secret places [where spirits are thought to dwell];
Who eat swine's flesh,
And their pots hold the broth of unclean meat;
AMP.5:
Who say, 'Keep to yourself, do not come near me,
For I am too holy for you [and you might defile me]!'
These [people] are smoke in My nostrils,
A fire that burns all the day.
AMP.6:
"Indeed, it is written before Me,
I will not keep silent, but I will repay;
I will even repay it [directly] into their arms,
AMP.7:
Both your own wickedness and the wickedness of your fathers," says the LORD.
"Since they too have made offerings with incense on the mountains
And scorned and taunted Me on the hills,
I therefore will measure [punishment for] their former work [directly] into their arms."
AMP.8:
This is what the LORD says,
"As the new wine is found in the cluster,
And one says, 'Do not destroy it, for there is a blessing and benefit in it,'
So I will do for the sake of My servants
In order not to destroy all of them.
AMP.9:
"I will bring forth descendants from Jacob,
And an heir of My mountains from Judah;
Even My chosen ones shall inherit it,
And My servants will live there.
AMP.10:
"And [the plain of] Sharon will be a place for flocks to graze,
And the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds,
For My people who seek Me [who long for Me and require My presence in their lives].
AMP.11:
"But you who abandon (turn away from) the LORD,
Who forget and ignore My holy mountain (Zion),
Who set a table for Gad [the Babylonian god of fortune],
And who fill a jug of mixed wine for Meni [the god of fate],
AMP.12:
I will destine you for the sword, [says the LORD],
And all of you will bow down to the slaughter,
Because when I called, you did not answer;
When I spoke, you did not listen or obey.
But you did [what was] evil in My sight
And chose that in which I did not delight."
AMP.13:
Therefore, the Lord GOD says this,
"Listen carefully, My servants will eat, but you will be hungry;
Indeed, My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty;
Indeed, My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
AMP.14:
"Indeed, My servants will shout for joy from a happy heart,
But you will cry out with a heavy heart,
And you shall wail and howl from a broken spirit.
AMP.15:
"And you will leave your name behind to My chosen ones [who will use it] as a curse,
And the Lord GOD will put you to death,
But He will call His servants by another name [a much greater name, just as the name Israel was greater than the name Jacob].
AMP.16:
"Because he who blesses himself on the earth
Will bless himself by the God of truth and faithfulness;
And he who swears [an oath] on the earth
Will swear by the God of truth and faithfulness;
Because the former troubles are forgotten,
And because they are hidden from My sight.
AMP.17:
"Behold, I am creating new heavens and a new earth;
And the former things [of life] will not be remembered or come to mind.
AMP.18:
"But be glad and rejoice forever over what I create;
Behold, I am creating Jerusalem to be a source of rejoicing
And her people a joy.
AMP.19:
"I will also rejoice in Jerusalem and be glad in My people;
And there will no longer be heard in her
The voice of weeping and the sound of crying.
AMP.20:
"No longer shall there be in it an infant who lives only a few days,
Or an old man who does not finish his days;
For the youth who dies at the age of a hundred,
And the one who does not reach the age of a hundred
Will be thought of as accursed.
AMP.21:
"They will build houses and live in them;
They will plant vineyards and eat the fruit.
AMP.22:
"They will not build and another occupy;
They will not plant and another eat [the fruit].
For as the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people,
And My chosen [people] will fully enjoy [and long make use of] the work of their hands.
AMP.23:
"They will not labor in vain,
Or bear children for disaster;
For they are the descendants of those blessed by the LORD,
And their offspring with them.
AMP.24: "It shall also come to pass that before they call, I will answer; and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
AMP.25: The wolf and the lamb will graze together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox [there will no longer be predator and prey]; and dust will be the serpent's food. They will do no evil or harm in all My holy mountain (Zion)," says the LORD.

NET.1: “I made myself available to those who did not ask for me; I appeared to those who did not look for me. I said, ‘Here I am! Here I am!’ to a nation that did not invoke my name.
NET.2: I spread out my hands all day long to my rebellious people, who lived in a way that is morally unacceptable, and who did what they desired.
NET.3: These people continually and blatantly offend me as they sacrifice in their sacred orchards and burn incense on brick altars.
NET.4: They sit among the tombs and keep watch all night long. They eat pork, and broth from unclean sacrificial meat is in their pans.
NET.5: They say, ‘Keep to yourself! Don’t get near me, for I am holier than you!’ These people are like smoke in my nostrils, like a fire that keeps burning all day long.
NET.6: Look, I have decreed: I will not keep silent, but will pay them back; I will pay them back exactly what they deserve,
NET.7: for your sins and your ancestors’ sins,” says the LORD. “Because they burned incense on the mountains and offended me on the hills, I will punish them in full measure.”
NET.8: This is what the LORD says: “When juice is discovered in a cluster of grapes, someone says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for it contains juice.’ So I will do for the sake of my servants — I will not destroy everyone.
NET.9: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah people to take possession of my mountains. My chosen ones will take possession of the land; my servants will live there.
NET.10: Sharon will become a pasture for sheep, and the Valley of Achor a place where cattle graze; they will belong to my people, who seek me.
NET.11: But as for you who abandon the LORD and forget about worshiping at my holy mountain, who prepare a feast for the god called ‘Fortune,’ and fill up wine jugs for the god called ‘Destiny’ —
NET.12: I predestine you to die by the sword, all of you will kneel down at the slaughtering block, because I called to you, and you did not respond, I spoke and you did not listen. You did evil before me; you chose to do what displeases me.”
NET.13: So this is what the sovereign LORD says: “Look, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry! Look, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty! Look, my servants will rejoice, but you will be humiliated!
NET.14: Look, my servants will shout for joy as happiness fills their hearts! But you will cry out as sorrow fills your hearts; you will wail because your spirits will be crushed.
NET.15: Your names will live on in the curse formulas of my chosen ones. The sovereign LORD will kill you, but he will give his servants another name.
NET.16: Whoever pronounces a blessing in the earth will do so in the name of the faithful God; whoever makes an oath in the earth will do so in the name of the faithful God. For past problems will be forgotten; I will no longer think about them.
NET.17: For look, I am ready to create new heavens and a new earth! The former ones will not be remembered; no one will think about them anymore.
NET.18: But be happy and rejoice forevermore over what I am about to create! For look, I am ready to create Jerusalem to be a source of joy, and her people to be a source of happiness.
NET.19: Jerusalem will bring me joy, and my people will bring me happiness. The sound of weeping or cries of sorrow will never be heard in her again.
NET.20: Never again will one of her infants live just a few days or an old man die before his time. Indeed, no one will die before the age of a hundred, anyone who fails to reach the age of a hundred will be considered cursed.
NET.21: They will build houses and live in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
NET.22: No longer will they build a house only to have another live in it, or plant a vineyard only to have another eat its fruit, for my people will live as long as trees, and my chosen ones will enjoy to the fullest what they have produced.
NET.23: They will not work in vain, or give birth to children that will experience disaster. For the LORD will bless their children and their descendants.
NET.24: Before they even call out, I will respond; while they are still speaking, I will hear.
NET.25: A wolf and a lamb will graze together; a lion, like an ox, will eat straw, and a snake’s food will be dirt. They will no longer injure or destroy on my entire royal mountain,” says the LORD.
